note: The only words the model may add around the facts in a finding or an answer about the data (docs/P1A-R2-DESIGN.md, R1). Written by the planning chat; no session edits this file. Lower case; a word is a run of letters and apostrophes. Left out on purpose: every number word, month name, age word, word of direction or comparison (more, fewer, up, down, rose, than, most), word of amount or closeness (some, about, roughly, over, under, nearly, only, just, each, every, per), word of time (year, month, last, now, still, then, from), 'or', 'another', 'like', 'can', 'could', 'would' and the single word 'record' ("a record 400"), 'not' and 'no' and every n't, every word for people, places or offenses, and every judgement. A reply that uses a word outside this list is replaced by Python's own sentence, so widening the list is safe to do slowly, from what the loop check shows.
